definitions.explanation: Cold-blooded vertebrate animals that live both in water and on land, typically having an aquatic larval stage. The class Amphibia in biological classification.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蛙|かえる}→蛙：04300_kaeru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{両生類|りょうせいるい}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

{両生類|りょうせいるい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水中|すいちゅう}→水中：13310_suichuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{陸上|りくじょう}→陸上：09245_rikujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Amphibians can live both in water and on land.

examples.japanese: {両生類|りょうせいるい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{敏感|びんかん}→敏感：06641_binkan⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Amphibians are sensitive to environmental changes.

notes:
{両生類|りょうせいるい} is a biological classification term. Composed of ⟦{両生|りょうせい}→両生：noentry⟧ ("both-living," i.e., amphibious) + ⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧ (class/type).

EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{蛙|かえる}→蛙：04300_kaeru⟧: frog
- ⟦{蝦蟇|がま}→蝦蟇：noentry⟧: toad
- ⟦{山椒魚|さんしょううお}→山椒魚：28706_sanshouuo⟧: salamander
- ⟦イモリ→イモリ：noentry⟧: newt

RELATED CLASSIFICATION TERMS:
- ⟦{哺乳類|ほにゅうるい}→哺乳類：04920_honyuurui⟧: mammals
- ⟦{爬虫類|はちゅうるい}→爬虫類：04921_hachuurui⟧: reptiles
- ⟦{鳥類|ちょうるい}→鳥類：04927_chourui⟧: birds
- ⟦{魚類|ぎょるい}→魚類：04925_gyorui⟧: fish

USAGE:
Amphibians go through metamorphosis from aquatic larvae (like ⟦おたまじゃくし→おたまじゃくし：noentry⟧, tadpoles) to terrestrial adults. This word appears in science classes and nature documentaries.
